messages:
Jordan (AE): Heads-up — running BlueHarbor POC perf run today 15:00-16:00 ET. Goals: validate steady 75 qps baseline, test 4x 90s micro-bursts to 300 conc, and capture tail latencies for SLO conversation. Need answers on pricing/commit options for steady vs burst.

Priya (Solutions): Thanks — can you paste the exact model + serving profile? also want to confirm whether KV prefix cache is on.

Jordan (AE): model: rw-llama-13b-int8. serving profile: dedicated d1-large (2 GPUs), batch_size=6, prefix cache TTL=60s, request timeout 15s. KV cache enabled.

Mateo (SRE): We can carve a reserved pool 14:50-16:10 ET to avoid noisy neighbors. autoscale off. I'll run three phases: 5m ramp, 30m steady, 4x 90s bursts.

Anya (Finance): Quick pricing ask: if they commit to 50 qps reserved monthly, what's suggested discount and how to price capped bursts?

Mateo (SRE): Loadgen snippet:
```
./loadgen --mode poisson --ramp 300 --steady 1800 --qps 75 --burst-spikes 4 --burst-qps 300 --burst-duration 90 --batch 6
```

Jordan (AE): BlueHarbor cares about tail (p99). also sent security questionnaire earlier — waiting on KMS and encryption answers.

sec-bot: Security checklist: SOC2 status: in progress. KMS integration: supported (customer-managed). Endpoint encryption: TLS 1.3.

Mateo (SRE): Run started 15:02 ET. dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/poc/blueharbor/run/1766667777

deploy-bot: perf-job 1766667777 started on d1-large (2 GPUs) by Mateo (SRE).

Priya (Solutions): Phase 2 steady @75 qps metrics?

Mateo (SRE): steady: p50 120ms, p95 310ms, p99 680ms. tokens/sec ~ 9.8k. CPU/GPU utilization stable ~ 64% GPU memory headroom.

Jordan (AE): good baseline. Anya any pricing calc back-of-envelope?

Anya (Finance): rough: steady 50 qps reserved commit -> 12% discount off on-demand token rate. Burst surcharge: charge on-demand + 30% premium for overflow reservations, with monthly cap. For this profile a 300-conc 90s spike ~ 1.6M tokens -> burst charge ≈ $120 per spike. Will model in spreadsheet.

Mateo (SRE): Running first micro-burst now.

Mateo (SRE): burst #1 p95 -> 560ms, p99 -> 1.4s, small queue observed ~2s at ingress for a handful of requests. KV cache warmed after spike 1 -> improved tail on later spikes.

Priya (Solutions): Noted. Can we recommend an ops pattern for them: small reserved headroom + fallback to rw-llama-7b-int8 for requests that hit queue > 500ms?

Mateo (SRE): Yes — fallback routing to a lower-latency variant reduces p99 significantly (tested offline). Also increasing batch_size to 8 reduced p95 by ~12% during steady in our micro-test; tradeoff is slightly higher per-request latency for tiny prompts.

Jordan (AE): Add that to the customer-facing runbook. Also need a short blurb for the security questionnaire about KMS latency and key handling.

sec-bot: KMS note: initial key unwrap ~3-6ms dependent on HSM; envelope key caching avoids per-request HSM roundtrip. Recommend envelope keys + local cache for Private.

Priya (Solutions): Post-run summary I'll paste into the deck:
- Steady (75 qps): p50 120ms, p95 310ms, p99 680ms, tokens/sec ~9.8k
- Bursts (300 conc, 90s): typical p95 520-620ms, p99 1.2-1.6s, brief ingress queueing on first spike
- Mitigations: reserved headroom, smaller model fallback, bump batch_size to 8, more aggressive prefix cache TTL

Mateo (SRE): artifacts uploaded: https://console.redwood.ai/poc/blueharbor/artifacts/1766667777.zip heatmaps + per-route traces attached.

Anya (Finance): Next step for commercial: propose 12% reserved discount at 50 qps commit + burst cap pricing (example cap: $10k/month max for overflow). I'll draft a proposal and loop legal.

Jordan (AE): Action items: 1) Priya update runbook + deck, 2) Mateo schedule a 6-hour soak at 50 qps to validate thermal stability, 3) Anya draft commercial terms and burst cap language, 4) sec-bot feed into questionnaire.

Mateo (SRE): I'll schedule the soak for Thu 03:00 PT.

Jordan (AE): Thanks all. closing thread after artifacts reviewed. :rocket:
